name: telegram
description: Telegram chat bridge. Mirrors chat.input / chat.response between the brAIn bus and a Telegram bot (paste a BotFather token to connect).

default_subscriptions.description: Mirrored to Telegram for every known chat (except when the message itself originated from Telegram — loop guard via metadata.platform).
Brain (or other node) replies (exact-topic flavor used by the default seed).
Brain (or other node) replies with a sub-topic suffix (e.g. chat.response.user1).
UI control plane — `{action: connect|disconnect|logout|status}`. The UI publishes here from `system.telegram-ui` after saving a new bot_token so the handler picks the change up immediately.

inputSchema.title: TelegramBridgeControl
inputSchema.description: Control message for the Telegram bridge. Accepted either as a parsed JSON payload.content or as metadata fields.

action.description: connect: (re)start the bot using the resolved token. disconnect: stop the bot but keep the cached token. logout: stop the bot and wipe the on-disk token cache. status: re-publish bridge.telegram.status + bridge.telegram.chats.
